correctness.rationale: For a connected cactus, m=n-1+q, so q disjoint balanced cycle relations exhaust the affine kernel. Each 2k-cycle factor is a free sum of two (k-1)-simplices with unique barycentric center and s=k-1; each bridge is a singleton. For affine joins, reflect each factor and derive s+1>=sum_i(s_i+1), with equality forcing each center and barycentric weight, yielding s=H-1 and uniqueness. For each edge, choosing H-1 distinct complementary roots proves the matching reflection upper certificate. Independently verified a balanced 4-cycle with two bridges by six exact rational reflection identities. No finite check substituted for universal cactus proof.
